authorization: Existing instruction to diagnose any failure and optimize system problems immediately.
cold_resources: 64GiB shared per cohort, never per VM; CXL adds real physical RAM; SSD is storage
global_quota: existing waterfill + settle_grants, guest grants delivered over existing telemetry channel; credit comes from actual controlled DRAM residency
pressure: per-node fast memory use, controlled residency, PSI, reclaim; compare same medium/capacity/layout
known_limit: nested PEBS unsupported; no claim of sampled promotion/exchange unless measured
old_baseline: v3 completed cohorts retained only as correctness and performance references
scope: SSD P/F at N8, 7GiB shared DRAM, 64GiB aggregate swap, three paired repetitions; same controller and reserve policy as v11.
comparison: P/F use the same v11 implementation and matched scaled reserve/payload ceiling; 7GiB validates a boundary neighbor, does not prove a universal capacity limit.
known_measurement_limit: Version v10 reserve differs from earlier fixed 1GiB versions; do not pool performance across versions.
previous_completed: v11: 6GiB SSD P global L1 OOM at 449.135s after release; controllers alive with fresh heartbeats, no L2 memcg OOM.
regression: 8GiB CXL OOM fixed by adaptive managed-capacity guard in v6; v7 increases pressure
common_guard: managed fast capacity, runtime nonpayload occupancy, 1GiB reserve; shrink immediately, grow only on observed physical headroom; settle physical credit for both policies
control_label: F: phase-blind equal share under same common host reserve guard; not the immutable-v5 static-quota treatment
numerator_definition: DRAM-only denominator; CXL/SSD capacity ratios separate; offline host numerator still under profiling review
code_delta: Only configuration, versioned paths, and three published arrival schedules; no memory or health algorithm change.
operational_stop_policy: No automatic workflow cutoff. The v7 F/SSD severe timeout is explicitly user-directed, right-censored, and a control performance result rather than a PhaseTieing P failure.
